title: usage.json — explicitly handed spend record
description: What the agent or a usage adapter hands the budget gate through VERDICT_USAGE: one measured run per record (a single object) or a run log (an array). The gate joins each record against past cost records by its window and prices comparable runs from usd, preferring it over the self-reported est_usd; records without usd never become a measured claim. verdict never discovers these files — the operator names them explicitly. Unknown keys are ignored, so newer writers stay readable.

model.description: Model that burned the tokens, when known; absent reads unknown, never priced.

tokens.description: Token counts for the window, when known; absent reads as unknown, never zero.

usd.description: Measured session price in USD, when the measurer priced it; the tool never prices tokens itself.

source.description: Free-form measurer name (e.g. claude-code, opencode); carried into data.estimate.harness when the record prices a run.

started_at.description: Window start (RFC 3339); the joined cost record's mtime must fall inside it.

ended_at.description: Window end (RFC 3339), never before the start.

usageTokens.description: Token counts for one usage record: input and output plus the provider-reported cache subsets.

cache_read.description: Input tokens served from cache; a subset of input, never an addition.

cache_write.description: Input tokens spent writing the cache; a subset of input, never an addition.
